en.title: 3. Tournament Registration & Squad Entry
en.excerpt: A complete guide for archers and club representatives to register for tournaments, configure athlete profiles, select filtered categories, build team squads, and complete payments.

toc.text: 2. Choosing Registration Type & Instant Profile Sync

en.content:
1. Overview of the Registration Workflow

Archeris provides a modern, 3-step tournament registration flow designed for both individual athletes and team managers or contingent representatives. You can find the registration page by visiting any published tournament (e.g., /tournaments/[slug]) and clicking the Register Now / Daftar Sekarang button.

The registration process is organized into three straightforward stages:

  1. Step 1: Archer Profile & Registration Type: Choose between individual athlete registration or contingent representative mode, and ensure your athlete profile is up-to-date.
  2. Step 2: Category Selection & Squad Builder: Select eligible competition divisions with automatic gender filtering and assemble team rosters.
  3. Step 3: Review & Payment: Inspect a clean itemized fee breakdown and complete payment via instant digital gateways (QRIS/VA) or bank transfer.

2. Choosing Registration Type & Instant Profile Sync

In Step 1, you can choose between two flexible registration modes:

  • Individual / Self & Team (Pemanah & Tim): Choose this mode if you are an archer registering for yourself in individual divisions or serving as the captain for your team. The form displays your essential athlete information: Full Legal Name, Gender, and Archery Club.
  • Representative / Group Entry (Perwakilan / Mendaftarkan Atlet Lain): Choose this mode if you are a coach, club official, or parent registering athletes on their behalf. This generalist mode allows clubs to enroll participants without locking the transaction to a single personal identity.
Instant Database Synchronization: When you complete or adjust your profile information in Step 1 and click Continue to Categories, Archeris immediately synchronizes and saves your profile to the database. You will never have to re-enter your club or profile details for future tournaments.

3. Smart Gender Filtering & Category Selection

Once you proceed to Step 2, the system presents all open competition categories configured by the tournament organizer. Archeris incorporates intelligent validation to keep registration effortless:

  • Gender-Specific Filtering: The category list dynamically adjusts based on your profile's gender. Male archers only see Male and Open divisions, while Female archers only see Female and Open divisions.
  • Multi-Category Selection: You can select multiple categories in a single tournament (for example, Recurve Individual Men and Recurve Mixed Team) subject to event schedule compatibility.
  • Real-Time Quota Status: Each category card displays live available slots and registration fees, preventing overbooking.

4. Building Team & Mixed Team Squads

When you select a team division (such as Men's Team, Women's Team, or Mixed Team), the Squad Roster Builder activates:

  1. Set Squad Name: Name your contingent or club squad (e.g., Eagle Archery Club A).
  2. Assign Teammates: Select or search for verified Archeris athletes to join your squad roster. For Mixed Team events, the system automatically checks that your pairing meets the male/female composition requirement.
  3. Slot Reservation: Once the squad roster is set, your team's slot in the bracket is reserved.

5. Itemized Fee Review & Payment Methods

In Step 3, you receive a transparent, itemized fee summary detailing each category entry, squad fee, and applicable administrative costs without cluttered UI badges or complex formulas.

Archeris supports multiple secure payment channels:

  • Instant Payment Gateway (QRIS & Virtual Account): Scan an instant QRIS barcode from any mobile banking or e-wallet app (BCA, Mandiri, GoPay, OVO, ShopeePay, Dana), or use a dedicated Virtual Account number. Confirmation is automatic within seconds.
  • Manual Bank Transfer: For institutional or club accounts requiring direct wire transfers, upload your transfer receipt directly through the portal for fast organizer verification.

Upon successful payment confirmation, you will receive your digital participant accreditation pass, entry receipt, and immediate inclusion in the official tournament target roster.
